artDirection: Sparse monochrome wireframe animal headshots. Transparent background and open spaces; no filled surfaces or black tiles. Existing Lumos identity retained. GALAH reuses the separately documented project identity.

assets.name: moose
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent website identity, ONE animal head, no text. Create a close-up frontal MOOSE head with recognisable broad palmate antlers, complete silhouette comfortably inside a square composition, large head occupying 85% of the canvas. True transparent alpha background and transparent open spaces BETWEEN EVERY wire. Draw only sparse dark charcoal #17191b contour wires: graceful curved longitude/latitude cage lines describing the three-dimensional head, muzzle, ears and antlers. Match a restrained scientific 3D wireframe humanoid visual language: approximately 12-18 generous curved surface lines, medium-thin clean lines that remain readable at 54px. Anatomical and elegant, calm symmetrical face, no cartoon expression. NO surface fill, NO solid fur, NO shading, NO dense triangulation, NO tiny crosshatching, NO color, NO glow, NO halo, NO background, NO floor, NO shadow, NO border, NO lettering. This is pure open sparse wire sculpture, NOT a realistic rendered animal covered with a mesh.
assets.encoding: cwebp -lossless; no pixel edits, no cropping, original alpha retained
